answer_1.quote: This reasoning is essential for many downstream tasks such as table-based fact verification and table-based question answering (TableQA).
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to questions or verification statements

answer_2.quote: For the WikiTQ and WikiSQL dataset, exact match (EM) accuracy was used to check if the predicted answers were the same as the correct ones. To evaluate FeTaQA, metrics such as ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L were used.

answer_4.quote: a human evaluation was conducted across four aspects: fluency (assessing linguistic errors), correctness (ensuring accurate answers to questions), faithfulness (verifying grounding on the input table), and adequacy (evaluating the comprehensiveness of the generated sentence in covering all answers)
answer_4.guideline: Evaluated across four aspects: fluency, correctness, faithfulness, and adequacy
